en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. In front of the cathedral stands an ornate baroque fountain with statues and flowing water. On the left is a smaller fountain topped by a bird sculpture. A tall bell tower with an onion-shaped dome rises on the right side of the cathedral. A few people in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the cobbled square. At the top of the card, printed in red, is the title indicating the location.
